title: security-platform findings document v1 (one collector run)

schema_version.description: "1.<minor>" of the contract the producer wrote (1.0 base, 1.1 complete_scope, 1.2 gap checks). Consumers accept any 1.x and reject other majors.

name.description: Collector name; the ledger resolves (fixes) only findings of this name. Equals SP_COLLECTOR_NAME when set.

tools.description: Third-party tools used and their versions (e.g. {"trivy": "0.58.0"}).

run.description: When the run happened. finished_at is the instant fixes and heartbeats are dated with.

asset.description: An asset id (<type>:<rest>) or a part of one (<asset>/<part>, narrow gaps).

reason.description: Why a gap (one line, no secret).

complete_scope.description: (1.1) On an ok entry: an asset prefix this run inventoried COMPLETELY and authoritatively. Findings of this collector under the prefix on assets the run did not list are closed as asset_retired.

checks.description: (1.2) On a gap entry <asset>/<part>: fnmatch patterns of the only checks that could not be evaluated on <asset>; their findings keep state, the asset's other findings are judged normally.

coverage.description: What the run looked at. ok = the asset was evaluated (absent findings on it may be fixed); gap = it could not be (its findings keep their state). No entry = out of this run's scope (unknown).

id.description: sha1("<layer>|<asset>|<check>") hex, first 12 characters: stable across runs and implementations.

check.description: Stable check name; never reused for another meaning.

asset.description: <type>:<rest>; types in use: host, image, repo, net-endpoint, secret-file, k8s-cluster, k8s-workload, k8s-namespace, k8s-identity, cis, cloud, agent-guard, identity, ...

evidence.description: Pointer into the run directory (raw/<collector>/<file>[#key]); never a secret value.

needs_human.description: true when no automation can fix it (a password, a physical step).

owner.description: A team name, or the role hints platform / human.

observed_at.description: When this run saw it; first_seen/last_seen in the ledger come from it.

kind.description: OCSF class: detection 2004, vulnerability 2002, compliance 2003. Optional; producers SHOULD set it (see LEDGER-D1).

refs.description: References, e.g. CVE ids, cis:<section> (OCSF compliance.standards).

attributes.description: Free-form; known keys: cve, cvss, epss, kev, exposed, published_at, kev_added, package, installed, fixed, base_severity, pillar.

findings.description: One entry per (layer, asset, check); duplicates in one document are not allowed.

metrics.description: Collector-reported gauges; re-exported with label collector=<name>. Names security_*; never asset details in labels.

description: One findings document = the output of ONE collector run. Contract findings/1.x (contracts/findings/SPEC.md). Unknown fields are ignored by consumers, never fatal.
$comment: Constraints MUST stay identical to schema/findings-v1.schema.json (the copy the core loads); tests/test_contracts.py checks it.
